description: The exact original Might and Magic VII four-legged mechanical construct: compact very dark gunmetal armored central chassis, bright small circular ivory-white front lamp, lower blue-violet grille/vent and small hanging dark geometric sensor. Four splayed thin long tapered polished steel spike legs connected by angled ribbed dark metal struts to weathered bronze cylindrical shoulder joints with short silver piston shafts projecting above. A narrow articulated bronze and black mechanical neck reaches forward/up to a small angular reptile-like metal head with vivid green optical lenses and a short blunt toothed metal jaw. Long slender segmented bronze cable-like tail arches backward and upward from the rear chassis, with small triangular metal spikes along one side. Exact native four-leg anatomy, head size, tail curvature and equipment; no humanoid body or hands, flesh, clothing, wheels, additional legs or weapons. Dark worn metal surfaces with restrained fine seams and rivets, native green optics and pale lamp. Preserve the source silhouette, thin spike feet and open gaps; no environment, floor shadow, added glow or energy effects. Copy only native effects when explicitly visible in action frames. There is one native palette; retain its original bronze, dark steel and green lens colors throughout.
